configurations.label: Flaps 10°
notes: Obstacle distances are to clear 15 m.
configurations.source: FR172H take-off distance table, flaps 10 deg, hard surface runway.

configurations.label: Flaps 40°, power off
notes: Reduce landing distance 10% for each 5 knots headwind.
For operation on a dry grass runway, increase both ground roll and total distance to clear obstacle by 20% of the total-to-clear-15m-obstacle figure.
Obstacle distances are to clear 15 m.
configurations.source: FR172H landing distance table, flaps lowered to 40 deg, power off, zero wind, hard surface runway.

weightBalance.source: R172K W&B XLSX converted from kg, liters, inches, pounds and lb-in/1000 to kg, meters and kgm.

configurations.label: Flaps 10°, short field
notes: Short field technique as specified in Section 4.
Decrease distances 10% for each 9 knots headwind.
For operation with tail winds up to 10 knots, increase distances by 10% for each 2 knots.
For operation on a dry grass runway, increase distances by 15% of the ground roll figure.
configurations.source: R172K POH take-off distance, short field, maximum weight 2550 lb plus 2400/2200 lb sheet.

configurations.label: Flaps 40°, short field
notes: Short field technique as specified in Section 4.
Decrease distances 10% for each 9 knots headwind.
For operation with tail winds up to 10 knots, increase distances by 10% for each 2 knots.
For operation on a dry grass runway, increase distances by 40% of the ground roll figure.
configurations.source: R172K POH landing distance, short field, maximum weight 2550 lb.
